window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.
window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.
